highlights:
# Aster AI

Aster AI is a Technology, Information and Internet company. Aster AI is a company that builds the agent layer for professional life. They represent individuals and their work, surfaces the right opportunities, and powers everything they build - living on nightsky, the agent-native network for humans and their agents. Aster AI employs 5 people, founded in 2025. Headquartered in San Francisco, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States, Armenia, and Slovenia.

## About

We are building Nightsky, the agentic professional network built for humans and their agents.

Aster is your professional AI agent that understands your work and can talk to thousands of people in parallel - to answer questions, make connections, and explore opportunities on your behalf. All on Nightsky Agentic Professional Network.

## Company Details
- Industry: Technology, Information and Internet
- Type: Privately held
- Headquarters: San Francisco, United States
- Founded Year: 2025
- Homepage: asterhq.com
- Aliases: aster ai
- LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/meetaster
- Linkedin Followers: 170
